# Devflow: briefing → context → plan → execution → review → completion,
# served by devpit's MCP. This file is the source of truth: devpit edits
# it and never commits it.
version: 1

# Switched on by the person's click in the devpit app, never by an agent.
enabled: false

stages:
  # approve: person stops for the person's yes; none goes on.
  briefing:
    enabled: true
    approve: person
  context:
    enabled: true
  plan:
    enabled: true
    approve: person
  execution:
    enabled: true
    # Run by devpit from the project's root for the evidence on the card.
    # report: junit | vitest | jest | cargo | none
    checks:
      - name: unit
        run: make test
        report: junit
  review:
    enabled: true
  completion:
    enabled: true
    gate: devflow-done

review:
  # The agent CLI each persona runs in; a persona not listed is
  # reviewed by the session itself.
  reviewers: []
  block_on: [critical, high]
  # How several reviewers' findings become one: jev (Decisions, else a
  # model pass), agent (one model pass) or none (merged as they are).
  consolidate: jev

# Decisions (Jev) answers typed questions about the gates. shadow logs
# them; enforce blocks, and waits for the person's click in the app.
# It is sent findings, criteria with their evidence, the brief and the
# plan — never the diff — through the provider in Settings → Decisions
# (OpenRouter unless changed), with no retention and no training.
# rubrics: a stage's own rubric, from .devpit/devflow/rubrics/.
decisions:
  use: false
  mode: shadow
